### aud.access_log

Views and exports of sensitive fields (salary, national IDs, bank accounts). Requirements: KRN-AUD-02, HRM-PRV-05. Source: kernel.yaml.

Partitioned by range; 37 partitions.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | uuid | no |  |  |
| occurred_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| actor_user_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| entity_type | text | no |  |  |
| entity_id | uuid | yes |  |  |
| fields | text[] | no | '{}'::text[] |  |
| action | text | no |  |  |
| row_count | integer | yes |  |  |
| created_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| created_by | uuid | no |  |  |
| correlation_id | uuid | yes |  | the request that showed the fields (spec 03 section 6.2; CR-028 P4) |

Constraints:

- `ck_access_log_action` CHECK ((action = ANY (ARRAY['view'::text, 'export'::text, 'print'::text])))
- `pk_access_log` PRIMARY KEY (id, occurred_at)

Indexes:

- `ix_access_log_actor_user_id_occurred_at` CREATE INDEX ix_access_log_actor_user_id_occurred_at ON ONLY aud.access_log USING btree (actor_user_id, occurred_at)
- `ix_access_log_entity_type_entity_id` CREATE INDEX ix_access_log_entity_type_entity_id ON ONLY aud.access_log USING btree (entity_type, entity_id)

Triggers:

- `tg_access_log_append_only` CREATE TRIGGER tg_access_log_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON aud.access_log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION aud.tg_refuse_change()
- `tg_access_log_no_truncate` CREATE TRIGGER tg_access_log_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON aud.access_log FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION aud.tg_refuse_change()

### cfg.form_drafts

Autosaved drafts of long forms (the hire form first), kept for the person who started them and removed after cfg.drafts.keep_days. Requirements: ADM-UXA-05. Source: kernel.yaml.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | uuid | no |  |  |
| user_id | uuid | no |  | fk iam.users; the person who started the draft and the only one who may read or change it |
| form_key | text | no |  | the form, e.g. hrm.hire; at most 100 characters |
| record_id | uuid | yes |  | the record the form edits; empty for a new record |
| data | bytea | no |  | the form's values and the step reached (json, encrypted: a draft holds personal data); at most 64 KB before encryption |
| expires_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  | renewed on every save; the daily clean-up removes drafts past it |
| created_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| created_by | uuid | no |  |  |
| updated_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| updated_by | uuid | no |  |  |
| row_version | bigint | no | 1 |  |

Constraints:

- `fk_form_drafts_user_id` FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES iam.users(id)
- `pk_form_drafts` PRIMARY KEY (id)
- `uq_form_drafts_user_id_form_key_record_id` UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (user_id, form_key, record_id)

Indexes:

- `ix_form_drafts_expires_at` CREATE INDEX ix_form_drafts_expires_at ON cfg.form_drafts USING btree (expires_at)

### hrm.attendance_periods

Lock unit for attendance per company and pay group (FR-XM-26). Requirements: ATT-17, ATT-21, FR-XM-26. Pending rule (S1.31, placeholder hrm.todo_attendance_periods_lock): A locked period never reopens (FR-XM-26). Unlocking is allowed only if the locking run is cancelled before it is locked itself. Lock trigger covers attendance_days, leave_request_days, overtime_entries and approved regularization_requests dated in the period; changes after lock become hrm.retro_adjustments. Pack-supplied, tenant-overridable rate and slab tables (income tax slabs, EOBI, PESSI/SESSI, WWF, minimum wage). Requirements: PAY-17, PAY-20, PAY-21, POL-04, CPL-04. Pack updates create new versions with a future valid_from. Source: hrm-pay.yaml.

| code | text | no |  | e.g. pk.income_tax.salaried |
| company_id | uuid | yes |  | fk org.companies; null = pack or tenant-wide value |
| company_scope | uuid | no | generated: COALESCE(company_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) | generated always as coalesce(company_id, nil uuid) stored |
| source | text | no |  |  |
| kind | text | no |  |  |
| description_i18n | jsonb | no |  |  |
| pack_version | text | yes |  |  |
| valid_from | date | no |  |  |
| valid_to | date | yes |  |  |
| created_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| created_by | uuid | no |  |  |
| updated_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| updated_by | uuid | no |  |  |
| row_version | bigint | no | 1 |  |

Constraints:

- `ck_statutory_tables_code_code` CHECK ((((length(code) >= 1) AND (length(code) <= 40)) AND (code = btrim(code))))
- `ck_statutory_tables_description_i18n_object` CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(description_i18n) = 'object'::text))
- `ck_statutory_tables_kind` CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['slab'::text, 'rate'::text, 'ceiling'::text, 'lookup'::text])))
- `ck_statutory_tables_source` CHECK ((source = ANY (ARRAY['pack'::text, 'tenant'::text])))
- `ck_statutory_tables_valid_to` CHECK (((valid_to IS NULL) OR (valid_to > valid_from)))
- `ex_statutory_tables_company_scope_code` EXCLUDE USING gist (company_scope WITH =, code WITH =, daterange(valid_from, valid_to, '[)'::text) WITH &&)
- `fk_statutory_tables_company_id` FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES org.companies(id)
- `pk_statutory_tables` PRIMARY KEY (id)

### iam.sessions

Durable record of sign-in sessions (active copies cached in Valkey). Requirements: KRN-IAM-04, ADM-USR-24. Not strictly append-only: last_seen_at and revoked_* are updatable by the session service role only. From S1.05 the session service also replaces refresh_token_hash on every refresh (rotation, CR-010). From S1.05-r1 it also keeps previous_refresh_hash, the token replaced by the last rotation (reuse detection, CR-016). Source: kernel.yaml.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | uuid | no |  |  |
| user_id | uuid | no |  | fk iam.users |
| issued_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| last_seen_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  | updated by session service only (exception to append-only, documented) |
| expires_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| ip_address | inet | yes |  |  |
| user_agent | text | yes |  |  |
| revoked_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| revoked_reason | text | yes |  |  |
| created_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| created_by | uuid | no |  |  |
| refresh_token_hash | text | yes |  | SHA-256 (hex) of the current refresh token; replaced on every refresh |
| previous_refresh_hash | text | yes |  | SHA-256 (hex) of the refresh token replaced by the last rotation; only a match with it counts as reuse |

Constraints:

- `fk_sessions_user_id` FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES iam.users(id)
- `pk_sessions` PRIMARY KEY (id)

Indexes:

- `ix_sessions_user_id_issued_at` CREATE INDEX ix_sessions_user_id_issued_at ON iam.sessions USING btree (user_id, issued_at)

Triggers:

- `tg_sessions_append_only` CREATE TRIGGER tg_sessions_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON iam.sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION iam.tg_refuse_change('last_seen_at', 'revoked_at', 'revoked_reason', 'refresh_token_hash', 'previous_refresh_hash')
- `tg_sessions_no_truncate` CREATE TRIGGER tg_sessions_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON iam.sessions FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION iam.tg_refuse_change()

- `hrm.todo_attendance_days_lock` Pending rule for hrm.attendance_days, owned by S1.31: Trigger refuses updates when the period is locked; later changes create hrm.retro_adjustments (FR-XM-26).
- `hrm.todo_attendance_periods_lock` Pending rule for hrm.attendance_periods, owned by S1.31: A locked period never reopens (FR-XM-26). Unlocking is allowed only if the locking run is cancelled before it is locked itself. Lock trigger covers attendance_days, leave_request_days, overtime_entries and approved regularization_requests dated in the period; changes after lock become hrm.retro_adjustments.
- `hrm.todo_final_settlements_approval_needs_clearance` Pending rule for hrm.final_settlements, owned by S1.43: status may become approved only when clearance_status in (cleared, waived) (FR-XM-29)
- `hrm.todo_final_settlements_lock` Pending rule for hrm.final_settlements, owned by S1.43: Header and lines locked by trigger from approved onward; correction by cancel and reissue (FR-XM-05).
- `hrm.todo_goals_parent_cycle` Pending rule for hrm.goals, owned by S1.49: Cycle check trigger on parent_goal_id.
- `hrm.todo_leave_ledger_transfer` Pending rule for hrm.leave_ledger, owned by S1.32: Intra-group transfer posts transfer_out on the old employment and transfer_in on the new one with the same source_id (FR-XM-30).
- `hrm.todo_leave_request_days_daily_total` Pending rule for hrm.leave_request_days, owned by S1.32: trigger: sum(quantity) per (employment_id, leave_date) over non-cancelled requests <= 1 day (or shift hours for hourly leave)
- `hrm.todo_loan_installments_freeze` Pending rule for hrm.loan_installments, owned by S1.41: Frozen by trigger once status = deducted.
- `hrm.todo_loan_transactions_recovery_within_balance` Pending rule for hrm.loan_transactions, owned by S1.41: trigger: a recovery cannot exceed the outstanding balance
- `hrm.todo_nominations_shares_sum_to_one` Pending rule for hrm.nominations, owned by S1.20: deferred: shares per (person_id, scheme) on any date sum to 1
- `hrm.todo_pay_component_versions_base_cycle` Pending rule for hrm.pay_component_versions, owned by S1.34: base_component_ids: cycle check on save
- `hrm.todo_pay_periods_closed_period_guard` Pending rule for hrm.pay_periods, owned by S1.38: Trigger refuses new pay_inputs, retro_adjustments or installments targeting a closed period.
- `hrm.todo_pay_result_lines_lock` Pending rule for hrm.pay_result_lines, owned by S1.38: Lock: trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE once the parent pay run status is locked or later (FR-XM-05, PAY-33).
- `hrm.todo_pay_result_reversals_before_payment` Pending rule for hrm.pay_result_reversals, owned by S1.39: allowed only while no non-failed payment line exists for the result
- `hrm.todo_pay_results_lock` Pending rule for hrm.pay_results, owned by S1.38: Trigger refuses update and delete when the run status is locked or later. Lock: trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE once the parent pay run status is locked or later (FR-XM-05, PAY-33).
- `hrm.todo_pay_run_employees_lock` Pending rule for hrm.pay_run_employees, owned by S1.38: Lock: trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE once the parent pay run status is locked or later (FR-XM-05, PAY-33).
- `hrm.todo_pay_runs_lock` Pending rule for hrm.pay_runs, owned by S1.38: Lock: trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE once the parent pay run status is locked or later (FR-XM-05, PAY-33); status column may still advance (paid, posted, closed) through the run service only.
- `hrm.todo_pay_traces_lock` Pending rule for hrm.pay_traces, owned by S1.38: Lock: trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE once the parent pay run status is locked or later (FR-XM-05, PAY-33).
- `hrm.todo_payment_lines_sum_equals_net` Pending rule for hrm.payment_lines, owned by S1.40: deferred: sum of active lines per result equals pay_results.net
- `hrm.todo_positions_reporting_cycle` Pending rule for hrm.positions, owned by S1.22: Cycle check trigger on reports_to_position_id.
- `hrm.todo_provident_fund_accounts_transfer` Pending rule for hrm.provident_fund_accounts, owned by S1.44: On intra-group transfer the old account closes with a transfer entry and the new account opens with the balance (employment_events.carry_over).
- `hrm.todo_retro_adjustments_apply_once` Pending rule for hrm.retro_adjustments, owned by S1.39: applied_in_run_id may be set once (trigger); status pending -> applied is one-way.
- `hrm.todo_statutory_table_rows_lock` Pending rule for hrm.statutory_table_rows, owned by S1.36: Immutable by trigger once the parent version is effective or referenced by any run; change by a new table version.
- `hrm.todo_training_bonds_final_settlement_recovery` Pending rule for hrm.training_bonds, owned by S1.43: Active bonds appear in final settlement as bond_recovery (LND-06).
